statement: Dolphin real-Wiimote passthrough tracks output 0x14 speaker-enable bit 2 and 0x19 speaker-mute bit 2, plus the WiimoteEnableSpeaker configuration setting (default off). On incoming report 0x18 it forwards the encoded data only if that setting and report-state enable are on and the mute state is off. Otherwise it substitutes a rumble-only output while preserving the rumble bit. This is Dolphin's host forwarding policy, not evidence of which packets retail firmware accepts.

applicability.scope: Real source WiimoteReal.cpp 168-205, 260-291 and 872-875; MainSettings.cpp 210-215. Agrees on report IDs/enable-mute bit with wii-gap-wiibrew-speaker-control-reports; no original WiiBrew records modified.
